name: Cantabrana (Spain)
description: White field with a blue pall issuing from the hoist corners to the fly, the hoist triangle red and charged with the crowned municipal arms of Cantabrana (a tower and a mining tool on white and blue).
history: Municipal flag of Cantabrana; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
